scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is restricted to finite simple connected complete multipartite graphs. Its infinite-family proof is structural; the accompanying finite enumeration is only a stress test. The initiating sequence-b-coloring paper is very recent, so a later or poorly indexed concurrent result remains a literature risk. No claim is made for general bipartite graphs, co-cluster perturbations, or other b-coloring variants.
title: Sequence b-colorings of complete multipartite graphs are rigid
